observations.prompt: If I invest $1000 at 8% annual interest compounded monthly for 5 years, how much will I have? Show the formula, calculate step by step, and

answer.answer:
Compound interest calculation

Formula: A = P(1 + r/n)^(n*t)
P = 1000 USD
r = 0.08 (8% annual)
n = 12 (monthly)
t = 5 years

Step 1: periodic rate = r/n = 0.08/12 = 0.006666666666667
Step 2: number of periods = n*t = 12*5 = 60
Step 3: A = 1000 * (1 + 0.006666666666667)^60
Final amount: 1489.85 USD

Вот минимальная программа на языке Rust (list files in the current directory):

```rust
use std::fs;

fn main() -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let mut names: Vec<String> = fs::read_dir(".")?
        .filter_map(Result::ok)
        .filter(|entry| entry.path().is_file())
        .map(|entry| entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned())
        .collect();
    names.sort();
    for name in names {
        println!("{name}");
    }
    Ok(())
}
```

use std::fs;

fn main() -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let mut names: Vec<String> = fs::read_dir(".")?

Вот минимальная программа на языке Rust (list files in the current directory):

```rust
use std::fs;

fn main() -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let mut names: Vec<String> = fs::read_dir(".")?
        .filter_map(Result::ok)
        .filter(|entry| entry.path().is_file())
        .map(|entry| entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned())
        .collect();
    names.sort();
    for name in names {
        println!("{name}");
    }
    Ok(())
}
```

answer.answer:
Here is a minimal Rust list files in the current directory program:

```rust
use std::fs;

fn main() -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let mut names: Vec<String> = fs::read_dir(".")?
        .filter_map(Result::ok)
        .filter(|entry| entry.path().is_file())
        .map(|entry| entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned())
        .collect();
    names.sort();
    for name in names {
        println!("{name}");
    }
    Ok(())
}
```

use std::fs;

fn main() -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let mut names: Vec<String> = fs::read_dir(".")?
        .filter_map(Result::ok)
        .filter(|entry| entry.path().is_file())
        .map(|entry| entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned())
        .collect();
    names.sort();
    for name in names {
        println!("{name}");
    }
    Ok(())
}
